text:
maria (partnerships): Heads-up — CloudZone reached back on EU-NE3 availability. They can commit 8x A100-equivalent nodes for launch, but need marketplace SKU entitlements cleared by next Tues.
ajay (infra): Nice. Do we have quotas/regions mapped in the console for EU-NE3? I recall GCP had a soft limit there.
sarah (legal): Quick flag — partner contract addendum required for marketplace listing. I can draft, but need the final SKU names and revenue split.
leo (sales): We confirmed pref names: CZ-eune3-dedicated and CZ-eune3-burst. Partner expects 2-week visibility on price before public announcement.
cloudzone-partner: Confirming: 8 nodes reserved, reserved until 2026-08-15. We will provide AMI/container images and a partner support contact. Need Redwood's marketplace SKU IDs and KMS guidance.
nate (ops): Ops checklist: 1) quota ticket to cloud provider 2) KMS key policy + onboarding 3) terraform module for node pool. I'll open tickets after infra confirms SKU.
ajay (infra): I'm checking quotas now. If we request 8 GPUs in EU-NE3 we'll need a service quota increase for GPUs and a VPC-ENI limit bump. ETA for approval depends on provider region backlog.
maria (partnerships): Can we draft the exact SKU strings now so legal/sales can proceed? Something like: redwood:marketplace:cz:eune3:dedicated:v1
sarah (legal): That SKU naming is fine as a placeholder. I'll start the addendum using that. Also need to know if partner will host keys or we use Redwood KMS.
cloudzone-partner: We prefer partner-managed KMS initially, but can switch to Redwood KMS for marketplace billing flows. We need the Redwood KMS policy template.
ajay (infra): KMS policy template: see: https://internal.redwood.dev/kms-templates (private). I'll drop a trimmed snippet below.
ajay (infra): ```
resource: "projects/redwood/kms/keyRings/eune3"
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
    members: ["serviceAccount:redwood-marketplace@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
```
maria (partnerships): @sarah @leo — legal + sales, assume 2-week signoff. We want to announce jointly on the 2026-08-20 company blog if everything aligns. Are we comfortable with that date?
leo (sales): 2026-08-20 looks good if pricing and SKU test pass by 08-10. Sales will prep partner co-marketing assets.
sarah (legal): Tentative okay. I'll aim to have the addendum ready for review by 08-06.
nate (ops): I'll open infra tickets now. Ticket IDs:
- QUOTA-4321 (GPU quota request)
- NETWORK-8210 (VPC ENI limit bump)
- KMS-2109 (policy + onboarding)

deploy-bot: Deployment plan created: https://deploys.redwood.dev/plans/3625001122-eune3 — contains canary and rollback steps.
ajay (infra): Ran a quick capacity sim — with the 8-node commit and default batching we expect ~200 rpm sustained for gen workloads. Will share perf dashboard once we provision test instances.
maria (partnerships): Action items: @ajay open quota requests and share perf dashboard; @sarah draft addendum with SKU placeholders; @nate open ops runbook; @leo prep co-marketing stub; @cloudzone-partner provide images and KMS preference doc by EOD Friday.
cloudzone-partner: Will send images and KMS doc by Friday EOD. Thanks everyone.
maria (partnerships): Great — if no objections I'll pin this thread and sync Monday 09:30 PT for final gating.
leo (sales): :thumbsup:
sarah (legal): fine with monday sync.
ajay (infra): onboarded the quota ticket (QUOTA-4321). Will update here.
